Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a quantitative cross-linking mass spectrometry (qXL-MS) study. While it uses a specific crosslinker (DSS), it does not fit the specific PTM-enrichment modifiers (like phospho or ubiquitin) listed in the provided ontology for Stage 4 modifiers. It is a standard DDA LFQ bottom-up workflow applied to cross-linked peptides.

scope: In this study, we take a biochemical approach using purified proteins to reconstitute a chaperone-mediated quality control mechanism associated with RNP granules and combine it with qXL-MS to probe PPIs inside condensates.
To investigate the condensate-specific interactions of FUS after phase separation, we diluted purified FUS-G156E protein, called FUSm throughout this manuscript
We therefore purified HspB8 (Figure 2—figure supplement 1A) and looked at its interaction with FUSm condensates in vitro.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on in vitro reconstituted condensates using purified recombinant FUS and HspB8 proteins. While the study discusses stress granules and cellular localization, the material actually analyzed by mass spectrometry consisted of purified proteins.
